clusters.headline: France expels Iranian diplomats, Iran bans French embassy staff

members.title: Во Франции заявили о высылке двух дипломатов Ирана
Иран запретил двум сотрудникам посольства Франции въезд в страну
Иран объявил двух французских дипломатов "нежелательными элементами"

clusters.summary: France announced the expulsion of two Iranian diplomats, prompting Iran to retaliate by declaring two French embassy employees persona non grata and banning them from entry into the country. The diplomatic dispute involved reciprocal actions against each other's diplomatic personnel.

clusters.headline: France legalizes euthanasia with Macron signing new law

members.title: Francia legaliza la eutanasia: Macrón promulga la ley sobre el derecho de la ayuda a morir
Macron ha firmato la legge che legalizza l'eutanasia in Francia

clusters.summary: French President Emmanuel Macron has signed legislation that legalizes euthanasia in France, according to reporting on the measure. The law establishes a legal framework for what is referred to as assisted dying or the right to aid in dying.
